snippet.title: The Pactmaker - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You are Edward Wolfe, a professor at a prestigious institution. All your lofty philosophy means nothing when you have to see your 12-year-old daughter lying in a coma after an accident.

You will do whatever it takes to save her, even if it means summoning a supernatural being, known as a Goetic. You must forge pacts and alliances with entities from this world and beyond, absorb and explore the memories of others, and uncover the truth.

Remember: everything comes with a price, and yours might just be too high to pay.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4394180/The_Pactmaker/

Developer: Alejandro Pascual
X: https://x.com/alexpact
